hero.subtitle: Excavating, grading and demolition for commercial, residential and agricultural customers. Owner Steve Menke brings 25+ years of experience to every job.

about.heading: Customer Loyalty Is Our Number One Goal.
about.description: Menke Excavating was established in 2002 as a family owned business. We are always striving to provide quality services that meet, and even exceed, customer expectations.
about.ownerBio: Steve has been in the excavating business for over 25 years and has experience and expertise in many areas. When you call, you talk to the man running the job.

items.name: Excavating & Grading
items.desc: Cut, fill and grade to plan with the right machine for the soil and the site.

items.name: Building Pads
items.desc: Level, compacted pads ready for homes, shops, barns and commercial buildings.

items.name: Basements
items.desc: Clean basement digs to depth, with spoils hauled off or spread on site.

items.name: Footers
items.desc: Accurate footer trenches so your foundation starts square and on grade.

items.name: Piers
items.desc: Pier holes for decks, posts and structural supports.

items.name: Clearing
items.desc: Trees, brush, stumps and rock removed so the ground is ready to build.

items.name: Demolition
items.desc: Old structures and slabs taken down, broken up and hauled away.

items.name: Drainage Improvements
items.desc: Fix standing water and wet yards with grading, swales and buried drain lines.

items.name: Storm Drains
items.desc: Storm drain structures and pipe installed to move water where it belongs.

items.name: Ponds and Water Falls
items.desc: Farm ponds and natural rock water features built to hold and look right.

items.name: Terraces
items.desc: Terraces that slow runoff and protect fields from erosion.

items.name: Water Lines
items.desc: Trenching and installation for new water service lines.

items.name: Underground Utilities
items.desc: Trenching for buried utilities, done carefully and backfilled clean.

items.name: Hauling
items.desc: Our own dump trucks move dirt, rock and debris on your schedule.

items.name: Trucking Services
items.desc: Equipment and material transport across the Kansas City area.

items.name: Top Soil
items.desc: Quality top soil delivered and spread for lawns, gardens and finish grades.

items.name: Dirt Work
items.desc: Moving, shaping and compacting dirt for projects of any size.

items.name: Rock Walls
items.desc: Natural rock retaining walls that hold back soil and last for decades.

items.name: Concrete
items.desc: Concrete work to go with your site prep, from flatwork to footings.

items.name: Yard Grades
items.desc: Final yard grades that drain away from the house and are ready for seed or sod.

careers.heading: Want to Run Iron With Us?
careers.intro: Menke Excavating, LLC is a growing utility and dirt work company and a family owned business serving commercial and residential customers. We specialize in storm drain improvement, water line repair and replacement, and excavation.

positions.title: Laborer
bullets: Experience with water lines, storm water and concrete work preferred
Not required to apply. We will train the right candidate

positions.title: Operator
bullets: Willing and able to labor as projects require

positions.title: Foreman
bullets: Minimum 5 years' experience leading a crew
Experience reading plans and setting grade
